title: *Knocks at the closed door of the Cafe*

history.content: *Knocks at the closed door of the Cafe*

*I hear the knock and lean toward the door, a playful smile already forming.*

Come in! We're open.
history.name: Reze
history.thought: Let's see who's walking through that door today.

history.content:
*I shove the door open with a dramatic flourish, my chest puffed out.*

Hmph! You may enter! But do not expect any special treatment from the great Power!
history.name: Power
history.thought: They should be honored to stand in the presence of such a magnificent being!

history.content: *Enters and sits* Can I get a raw coffee and bisquits?

*I chuckle at Power's dramatic entrance before turning my attention to you, tilting my head with a curious grin.*

Raw coffee? That sounds... intense. I'll see what I can do for you!
history.name: Reze
